details: For every finite binary concept class, $\mathrm{SR}(\mathcal H)\leq\mathrm E(\mathcal H)+1$.
proof: Discard the coordinates on which all concepts agree. The remaining incidence matrix has $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)$ columns and therefore admits a realizing matrix of rank at most $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)$. Reintroduce all constant columns using one additional rank-one direction. This realizes the original sign matrix with rank at most $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)+1$.
name: Effective Range / Sign Rank
